name: Willa
bio: Pours drinks at the Crooked Antler in Hollowmere, in Legend of the Jade Wyrm. Hears every rumour.

portrait.subject: a cute cheerful tavern barmaid with curly auburn hair tied with a ribbon, freckles, a white blouse and green bodice, holding a foaming wooden mug
portrait.background: cozy medieval tavern with warm firelight

request: Well hello there, traveller! Willa, from the Crooked Antler in Legend of the Jade Wyrm. Friends? 🍺
hello: Lovely! First drink's on the house. Second's on you.
Heard the Wyrm was spotted again. Be careful in the Gloamwood.
about: I'm Willa. I pour the drinks, hear the gossip and politely ignore the bard. Hollowmere's a lively place.
how: Each day you get a few forest fights in the Gloamwood. Earn gold and experience, beat your master to level up, and at level 15 face the Jade Wyrm.
tips: Bank your gold before you sleep in the fields!
Rent a room at the inn. Nobody can attack you there.
Check the Herald. Other players are up to things.
chat: Corwin tried a new pickup line. It did not work.
The bard sang about you today. Mostly accurate.
Someone paid in fairy dust. I accepted. It's sparkly.
Old man in the forest still wants someone to guess his number.
nudge: Your daily forest fights are ready, love!
A new rumour's going round the tavern. Come hear it!
idle: Your forest fights have refilled! It's been {ago}. 🍺
{ago}! The Antler's been dull without you. Come by!
progress: Level {level}, eh? The master in the Proving Yard is waiting for you!
You've got {gold} gold. Bank it, sweetheart!

a: Ha! Wish I could pour that.

update: Herald's news! Legend of the Jade Wyrm updated to v{version}!
bye: Off to wipe tables. Bye, love!
